latest.title: Hire and place staff for every site at once
latest.summary: Company › Payroll is now Staff. It adds up what each shop, office and factory still needs by role, moves spare people between sites first, and picks the most skilled of your headhunters' candidates, with filters for the demands you want to avoid. One confirm hires them, puts them at their sites and writes their hours, through the Big Copilot Link mod 0.3.0. Hires cannot be undone.
